findings.passage: Representative Willis and I stand before you today to speak on a critical issue that is facing our state and nation: election security and integrity.
findings.note: Opening of his written sponsor testimony on H.B. 472 before the House Homeland Security Committee. He frames the bill as an election security and integrity measure.

findings.passage: Key portions of the identity and citizenship verification update include: Increase the frequency of review for non-citizens and other ineligible voters, Provide counties with resources to verify identity and citizenship prior to registration and for absentee and provisional ballot screening, Expand voter registration instructions to assure citizenship and other eligibility requirements are reviewed, and Introduce safeguards and procedures at social services, BMV and registration agencies to ensure noncitizens are not misled into illegally registering to vote.
findings.note: In his sponsor testimony he lists what the bill does on identity and citizenship checks: more frequent review for non-citizens, county resources to verify identity and citizenship before registration and for absentee and provisional ballots, and safeguards at BMV and registration agencies. The list is joined from the bullet points of the PDF; the testimony does not mention photo ID.

findings.passage: Require that a voters registration match the information on the applicant’s driver’s license or state ID card,
findings.note: One of the voter-registration changes he lists in the same testimony: registration data to match the applicant's driver's license or state ID card.
